cards.text: Ezekiel is a priest living among the exiles by the River Kebar (Ezekiel 1:1-3). Far away, the king of Babylon has laid siege to Jerusalem (Ezekiel 24:2). Then the word of the LORD comes to Ezekiel.
God calls him son of man. Then He says He's about to take away the desire of Ezekiel's eyes with a fatal blow.

cards.question: When God takes away the desire of Ezekiel's eyes, Ezekiel is allowed to weep and let his tears flow.

cards.text: God says to groan quietly, not mourn for the dead, and not cover his lips. Friend, I've heard some hard words in my time, but that one stops me cold.

cards.question: God also tells Ezekiel what to put on. What does God tell him to wear?
God says Ezekiel may still eat the bread of mourners.
Ezekiel speaks to the people in the morning, and in the evening his ___ dies.

cards.text: The next morning, Ezekiel does just as he was commanded. Then the people ask him something.

cards.question: Ezekiel's wife has died, but he isn't mourning, and his turban and sandals are on. What do the people ask him?

answers.text: What his actions mean for them
Why God took his wife away
Why he isn't angry at God

cards.text: Ezekiel answers with the word of the LORD for the house of Israel. And here's the turn, friend: Ezekiel lost the desire of his eyes, and now God speaks about the desire of Israel's eyes.

cards.question: God says He is about to desecrate the desire of Israel's eyes, the pride of their power. What is it?
God also says the sons and daughters the people left behind will fall by the sword.

cards.text: Then Ezekiel tells them they'll do just as he has done. They won't cover their lips or eat the bread of mourners.

cards.question: Ezekiel says that when God desecrates His sanctuary, the people will take off their turbans and sandals.
Ezekiel says the people won't mourn or weep. Instead, they will waste away because of their ___.
God says Ezekiel will be a sign for the people, and they'll do everything he has done. When all this happens, what does God say they will know?

answers.text: That He is the Lord GOD
That Ezekiel is a true priest

cards.text: Then God speaks to Ezekiel himself about the day He takes away Israel's stronghold, their pride and joy, and their sons and daughters.
On that day, someone who escaped will come and tell Ezekiel the news.

cards.question: On the day someone who escaped brings Ezekiel the news, something changes for Ezekiel himself. What is it?

answers.text: He will speak and no longer be mute
He will be set free from his exile
He will see Jerusalem with his eyes

cards.text: So Ezekiel will be a sign to them, and they will know that He is the LORD.
